normalized.description: The study must provide information on groups/categories of products used by EU MoDs that contain PFAS substances (basing on the OECD 2021 definition), including specific focus on volumes of use in defence, technical function, the moment of emissions, as well as use cases in defence. The study must also analyse if available substitutes for PFAS in such groups of products exist. The study will also provide detailed information and analysis of a potential impact of PFAS-related EU regulatory risk management activities (including those in preparation) on the EU defence sector. On this basis, related recommendations will be developed and included in the study, for mitigation of related impacts on defence stakeholders.
